title: Make & ship: tiers, QC, unboxing
summary: Founder builds → home assemblers → bulk/workshop; ring supply, kits packed ahead, filmable packaging.

blocks.title: Hands first, then hands many
blocks.body: Production scales only after quality and timing are boring. Three tiers keep the craft honest while volume grows.

items.title: Founders by hand
items.detail: Every early SKU is built by the people teaching it. Proof of time, price floor, and filmable make.

items.title: Home assemblers
items.detail: Paid per accepted piece. Skill badge + QC sample before live orders.

items.title: Bulk / workshop
items.detail: Repeat bulk and event runs. Still the same QC bar; just more benches.

items.label: QC
items.detail: Size, weave integrity, color match, sharp-edge check before pack.

items.label: Ring supply
items.detail: Stock by color and gauge; reorder before a drop, not after.

items.label: Kits packed ahead
items.detail: Builder kits pre-bagged so a sale is label-and-ship.

items.label: Shipping / unboxing
items.detail: Packaging worth filming — soft wrap, color card, care note.

blocks.title: Time is a cost
blocks.body: Track minutes per piece at Tier 1 before you set a shop price or an assembler rate. Underpaying labor to win a listing is a risk, not a strategy — see Risks.

blocks.heading: From order to doorstep
items: Confirm SKU, colorway, and due date.
Pull from finished stock, kit shelf, or assign an assembler.
Pack for the camera, ship, log the turnaround.
